Text.Reusable␠live␠views␠built␠from␠Publ: Reusable live views built from PublisherStudio components.
Text.Review␠the␠application␠log␠for␠the␠: Review the application log for the underlying exception.
Text.Runs␠when␠this␠object␠is␠clicked␠in: Runs when this object is clicked in the exported animated website or presentation preview.
Text.SVG␠and␠animated␠images␠are␠preserv: SVG and animated images are preserved so vector data and animation are not flattened.
Text.Save␠capture␠identities␠once␠and␠se: Save capture identities once and select them from publication live-source objects.
Text.Scan␠this␠once␠with␠an␠Authenticato: Scan this once with an Authenticator app. The displayed URI contains only the enrollment seed at the moment you explicitly request it.
Text.Scripts␠execute␠with␠the␠permission: Scripts execute with the permissions of the exported page. Use only code you trust. PublisherStudio never enables script actions automatically.
Text.Secrets␠are␠encrypted␠for␠the␠signe: Secrets are encrypted for the signed-in operating-system user and never exported with the publication.
Text.Select a sequence segment to edit i: Wählen Sie ein Sequenzsegment aus, um es zu bearbeiten.
Text.Select a text box, picture, WordArt: Wählen Sie ein Textfeld, Bild, WordArt-Objekt oder eine Form aus.
Text.Selections␠use␠document␠coordinates: Selections use document coordinates, so rectangular, elliptical, freehand, magnetic, and arbitrary polygon cuts stay aligned at every layer angle and canvas size.
Text.Selectors␠are␠evaluated␠locally␠ins: Selectors are evaluated locally inside the exported file. No server or network request is needed. Use one chained signal per cell/chart part when a sequence must highlight several targets in order.
Text.Select␠any␠text,␠picture,␠audio,␠vi: Select any text, picture, audio, video, shape, connector, WordArt, or data visual to animate it.
Text.Select␠an␠installed␠system␠font␠or␠: Select an installed system font or type another font family
Text.Select␠a␠publication␠dataset,␠REST␠: Select a publication dataset, REST endpoint, or OData entity in Component Studio.
Text.Select␠a␠text␠box,␠picture,␠WordArt: Select a text box, picture, WordArt, or shape. Page and ruler settings are available on the Page tab.
Text.Select␠the␠models␠used␠by␠the␠\"AI␠: Wählen Sie die Modelle für die Chat-Auswahl „KI-Rat“.
Text.Share␠without␠stopping␠generation: Teilen, ohne die Generierung zu stoppen
Text.Single-flight␠scheduling␠waits␠for␠: Single-flight scheduling waits for capture and LocalGPT response before the next tick. Intervals are clamped to at least 15 seconds, so requests cannot pile up.
Text.Splitter,␠Tab␠Panel,␠Multi␠View,␠an: Splitter, Tab Panel, Multi View, and Scroll View host browser-native child controls. Each panel can use another publication dataset without a Blazor adapter.
Text.Standalone␠HTML␠uses␠its␠embedded␠s: Standalone HTML uses its embedded snapshot first, then JavaScript fetch. External servers must permit browser requests. Relative monolith routes can be reconnected with the exported page's
Text.Start␠conversion␠with␠the␠current␠p: Start conversion with the current preset and options
Text.Start␠the␠listener␠only␠while␠a␠str: Start the listener only while a streaming session is active.
Text.Stories␠are␠stored␠as␠Office␠Open␠X: Stories are stored as Office Open XML (DOCX). The canvas preview is generated as HTML.
Text.Subject: Subject
Text.Tests␠the␠official␠Twitch␠ingest␠li: Tests the official Twitch ingest list from this machine and selects the lowest reachable latency.
Text.The choice is stored for this brows: Die Auswahl wird für diesen Browser und in der Publikation für die Sprachmetadaten des eigenständigen HTML-Exports gespeichert.
Text.These␠authored␠layers␠render␠live␠o: These authored layers render live on camera, screen, window, browser-tab, capture-device, and network-video inputs. The compatibility controls above remain in their own protected layer.
Text.These␠machine␠profiles␠are␠reusable: These machine profiles are reusable across publications.
Text.These␠variants␠may␠be␠recorded␠even: These variants may be recorded even when their public provider output is disabled.
Text.The␠JSON␠object␠is␠merged␠after␠Pub: The JSON object is merged after PublisherStudio's generated safe options. It keeps the project file declarative and remains compatible with the single-file export.
Text.The␠RichEdit␠References␠→␠Add␠Text␠: The RichEdit References → Add Text menu contains the additional built-in field commands.
Text.The␠application␠choice␠is␠stored␠fo: The application choice is stored for this browser. The publication choice controls standalone HTML language metadata and remains editable per document.
Text.The␠canvas␠blob␠remains␠interactive: The canvas blob remains interactive in HTML export. The OpenSCAD solid is an interchange/render source and must be baked for native mesh-quality video output.
Text.The␠canvas␠uses␠the␠same␠DataVisual: Die Arbeitsfläche verwendet dieselben DataVisual-, DevExtreme-, Medien-, Live-Quellen-, HTML- und verschachtelten Panel-Renderer wie Mainframe, Präsentation, eigenständiges HTML und strukturierter Website-Export.
Text.The␠complete␠DevExtreme␠chart-serie: The complete DevExtreme chart-series workbench plus pies, polar charts, sparklines, gauges, Sankey, funnel, pyramid, tree map, range selector, grid, and KPI.
Text.The␠complete␠reusable␠panel␠project: Das vollständige wiederverwendbare Panelprojekt wurde exportiert.
Text.The␠compositor␠captures␠the␠publica: The compositor captures the publication once at this resolution and frame rate.
Text.The␠current␠selection␠stays␠editabl: The current selection stays editable. Save any number of independent ranges as cut sections without replacing the active selection.
Text.The␠exporter␠keeps␠the␠original␠whe: The exporter keeps the original whenever conversion is unsupported or does not reduce the file.
Text.The␠original␠picture␠remains␠embedd: The original picture remains embedded in the publication and is clipped through the WordArt glyphs in every export.
Text.The␠panel␠was␠saved␠and␠remains␠reu: Das Panel wurde gespeichert und bleibt im Mainframe sowie in Exporten wiederverwendbar.
Text.The␠preview␠and␠both␠HTML␠exports␠u: The preview and both HTML exports use the same component JSON and browser runtime.
Text.The␠private␠identity␠is␠generated␠a: The private identity is generated at runtime and stored only in a local secret file. Regenerating or deleting it intentionally invalidates all previous trust relationships.
Text.The␠receiving␠frontend␠is␠authorita: The receiving frontend is authoritative. A matching rule controls discovery, invocation and the editor shown for requested human information. Scheduled and sequential spool work cannot bypass it.
Text.The␠recording␠pipeline␠remains␠isol: The recording pipeline remains isolated from every provider encoder.
Text.The␠request␠only␠enters␠LocalGPT␠af: The request only enters LocalGPT after this explicit frontend action. Any required PublisherStudio eye/hand call is still checked against the permission matrix below.
Text.The␠selected␠cells␠are␠embedded␠as␠: The selected cells are embedded as a snapshot and immediately become available to charts and data tables.
Text.The␠selected␠cells␠were␠copied␠into: The selected cells were copied into this publication data object. Create the selection again from Spreadsheet Studio to replace it with newer workbook values.
The selected layer has no filters.
Text.The␠single-file␠HTML␠export␠can␠cal: The single-file HTML export can call only endpoints the browser is allowed to reach. Any direct URL and header value required by the browser becomes part of the exported HTML. Never embed private credentials in a file you distribute.
Text.The␠source␠remains␠embedded.␠Trimmi: The source remains embedded. Trimming, fades, playback rate, and timeline placement are non-destructive.
Text.The␠spreadsheet␠runs␠locally␠inside: The spreadsheet runs locally inside PublisherStudio.
Text.The␠stream␠key␠is␠managed␠by␠the␠Tw: The stream key is managed by the Twitch OAuth connection and is not displayed in the editor.
Text.The␠transition␠belongs␠to␠this␠page: The transition belongs to this page and is used when the page becomes active.
Text.The␠value␠is␠returned␠through␠the␠e: The value is returned through the exact 1-Wire request only after you approve it in this PublisherStudio frontend.
Text.This␠Twitch␠authorization␠does␠not␠: This Twitch authorization does not include Chat scopes. Reconnect Twitch while “Connect live Chat” is enabled.
Text.This␠command␠applies␠to␠the␠active␠: This command applies to the active session.
Text.This␠is␠a␠built-in␠live␠object.␠Its: This is a built-in live object. Its rows are generated at render/export time and do not need a manual refresh or copied snapshot.
Text.This␠is␠the␠complete␠persisted␠modu: This is the complete persisted module state, including data/web connections, chart settings, fields, actions, filters and advanced options.
Text.This␠layer␠keeps␠its␠sanitized␠SVG␠: This layer keeps its sanitized SVG paths, paint servers, transforms and clipping definitions as vector markup. Position, size, rotation, opacity and layer order remain editable in Picture Studio.
Text.This␠menu␠is␠generated␠from␠the␠sel: This menu is generated from the selected data object or API. Use

Text.This␠menu␠uses␠its␠editable␠item␠li: This menu uses its editable item list. No dataset, API, key field, or CRUD configuration is required. Open

Text.Trust␠is␠reciprocal:␠repeat␠the␠ope: Trust is reciprocal: repeat the operation in LocalGPT with PublisherStudio's public ticket. Private keys and MFA seeds are never sent over 1-Wire.
Text.Twitch␠manual␠Chat␠uses␠account␠nam: Twitch manual Chat uses account name, channel, and an OAuth token. YouTube uses the Channel / account ID as the live-chat ID plus an OAuth token with live-chat permissions.
Text.Type␠or␠select␠a␠system␠font: Type or select a system font
Text.Upgrading␠this␠legacy␠HTML␠story␠to: Upgrading this legacy HTML story to DOCX so page layout, fonts, fields, colors, headers, and footers work correctly…
Text.Uses␠the␠same␠runtime␠and␠interacti: Uses the same runtime and interactions as the matching single-file export.
Text.Use␠bundled␠keyless␠Vector␠Map␠inst: Use bundled keyless Vector Map instead
Text.Use␠one␠LAN␠encode␠for␠the␠enabled␠: Use one LAN encode for the enabled internal delivery protocols.
Text.Use␠the␠current␠editor␠page␠as␠prog: Use the current editor page as program.
Text.Use␠the␠platform's␠test␠route␠when␠: Use the platform's test route when supported.
Text.Use␠the␠self-updating␠Publication␠p: Use the self-updating Publication pages object
Text.Use␠this␠provider␠and␠channel␠as␠a␠: Use this provider and channel as a compositor Chat context.
Text.Viewers␠never␠receive␠the␠answer␠fi: Viewers never receive the answer field
Text.Visuals␠remain␠live␠DevExpress␠comp: Visuals remain live DevExpress components on the publication canvas. Web bindings are refreshed by the local monolith and standalone HTML can optionally continue polling with embedded JavaScript.
Text.WebM␠VP9/VP8␠+␠Opus␠—␠optional␠brow: WebM VP9/VP8 + Opus — optional browser conversion
Text.WebM␠conversion␠runs␠locally␠in␠the: WebM conversion runs locally in the browser and can take approximately the video duration.
Text.Welcome␠to␠your␠LocalChatGPT,␠go␠to: Willkommen bei LocalChatGPT. Öffnen Sie die Einrichtungsseite, um die KI-Chat-Clients zu konfigurieren.
Text.Workbook␠data␠is␠embedded␠in␠the␠pu: Workbook data is embedded in the publication. The canvas uses a safe static worksheet preview.
Text.Write␠the␠requested␠text␠and␠return: Write the requested text and return it as a reviewable PublisherStudio insertion proposal.
Text.XLSX,␠XLSM,␠XLS,␠CSV,␠and␠TXT␠·␠edi: XLSX, XLSM, XLS, CSV, and TXT · edited legacy/text files save as XLSX · XLSM macros are preserved but cannot run or be edited
Text.You␠can␠connect␠different␠Cloud␠and: Sie können verschiedene Cloud- und lokale KI-Modelle verbinden. Vorher kann das Chat-Modul nicht über die Navigation geöffnet werden.
Sie können verschiedene Cloud- und lokale KI-Modelle verbinden, bevor Sie das Chat-Modul über die Navigation öffnen.
